instruction: Look at freecad_task-4_input.step in FreeCAD. Convert the plain 160 mm long shaft into a hollow stepped shaft assembly. Keep the original shaft length and axis along X. Add and fuse three coaxial collars, each 12 mm wide along X and outside diameter 44 mm, centered at X=35, 80, and 125 mm. Cut a coaxial through bore of diameter 10 mm through the complete shaft length. Cut two top keyways centered on the shaft Y=0 plane: one from X=20 to X=65 and one from X=95 to X=140, each 9 mm wide along Y and 4 mm deep below the top surface of the 24 mm shaft. Cut one cross-drilled hole of diameter 7 mm through each collar along the Y direction at the collar center. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-4_output.step through the GUI only; do not use script files.
